data.name: Draupadi
data.gender_notes: Draupadi is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Patronymic from Drupada, king of Panchala — 'daughter of Drupada'. Its root is Sanskrit drupada + ī. Draupadi, wife of the five Pandavas in the Mahabharata. Draupadi is a Sanskrit name meaning “Daughter of Drupada”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Draupadi expresses “Daughter of Drupada”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Patronymic from Drupada, king of Panchala — 'daughter of Drupada'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Draupadi total 38, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

vedic_reference.note: Draupadi is a character from the Indian epic Mahabharata. She is the wife of the Pandava brothers and is known for her great beauty, intelligence, and generosity. The name 'Draupadi' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'draupada', which means 'generous breast'.

historical_references.reference: Draupadi, wife of the five Pandavas in the Mahabharata.
